title: Decoupled Safety Control: A Safety-Control Algorithm for Training-Free Safety Guidance
title_zh: 解耦安全控制：一种无需训练的安全引导算法

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种新的解耦安全控制方法，以提高扩散模型生成内容的安全性。 Diffusion models achieve strong performance in text-to-image generation, but they can still produce unsafe content. Training-free safety guidance offers a practical inference-time alternative that intervenes during sampling without modifying model weights. However, many existing safeguards still rely on a coupled safety-control chain. In this chain, the same unsafe condition simultaneously specifies what should be avoided, indicates the current unsafe signal, constructs the intervention, and determines when that intervention remains active. This coupling can work when unsafe factors are explicit, but becomes less reliable once harmful and benign semantics are entangled in the current generation state, often leaving residual unsafe content or unnecessarily degrading benign-generation quality or prompt fidelity. We address this problem with Decoupled Safety Control (DSC), a plug-in safety-control algorithm for training-free safety guidance. DSC reformulates training-free safety guidance as an explicit state-dependent control process, so the executed intervention is determined from the current generation state rather than inherited directly from a single unsafe condition. Experiments on standard safety benchmarks show that DSC improves representative latent- and text-space safeguards, achieving stronger unsafe-content suppression while preserving benign-generation quality and maintaining efficient inference.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种新的解耦安全控制方法，以提高扩散模型生成内容的安全性。扩散模型在文生图任务中表现优异，但仍可能生成不安全内容。 免训练安全引导提供了一种实用的推理时替代方案，它在不修改模型权重的情况下于采样过程中进行干预。 然而，许多现有的安全防护机制仍然依赖耦合的安全控制链。 在这条控制链中，同一个不安全条件同时指定了应避免的内容、指示当前的不安全信号、构建干预手段，并决定该干预何时保持生效。 这种耦合方式在不安全因素明确时可以奏效，但一旦有害语义与良性语义在当前生成状态中纠缠在一起，其可靠性就会下降，常常留下残留的不安全内容，或不必要地降低良性生成质量或提示词保真度。 我们通过解耦安全控制（DSC）来解决这一问题，这是一种面向免训练安全引导的即插即用安全控制算法。 DSC 将免训练安全引导重新表述为一个显式的状态依赖控制过程，使得实际执行的干预由当前生成状态决定，而非直接继承自单一的不安全条件。 在标准安全基准上的实验表明，DSC 改进了具有代表性的潜空间与文本空间安全防护方法，在保持良性生成质量与高效推理的同时，实现了更强的不安全内容抑制。
